objective: Speak to Dispatch Commander Ruag in Stonard.

description: Regret. It is all I have now. One bad decision resulting in several horrible outcomes. If only I had waited for those orders. Maybe they would have detailed the horrors that awaited us in those cursed lands! Maybe they were to redirect us to another detail? Ultimately, it was my fault. All of it was my fault.
So here I stand, awaiting orders. I must know. I must have those orders.
Dispatch Commander Ruag resides in Stonard. Find him and find out what became of the orders.
completion: Thrall's Grasp... The story is still fresh in my mind.
Terrible thing that happened to that regiment. The horde lost some of its best soldiers when that battalion was destroyed.
